boxes.name: Agent (MCP tools)
boxes.description: An AI agent authoring documents through the MCP tool groups; mutations go through the same API the browser uses.

boxes.name: Graph documents
boxes.description: *.graph.json — nodes and edges speaking one pack's vocabulary; churns with every pipeline run and authored edit.

contract.text: v3: nodes (kind, props, tags), edges (kind, from, to), pack reference. No positions stored; layout is computed at view time. Containment is not a node field — it is derived per view from contain-role edges.

boxes.name: Pack documents
boxes.description: *.pack.json — the stable vocabulary a graph speaks; changes at library cadence, not edit cadence.

contract.text: Node and edge kinds with props schemas, render templates, and views: node roles (spatial/latent/hidden), edge roles (contain/arrow/summary/hidden, cluster pending), layout choice.

boxes.name: Dataflow documents
boxes.description: *.dataflow.json — the Dataflow Designer's own format; no pack, the app is its own vocabulary.

contract.text: v1: boxes (id, name, description?, contract {format, text}?, group?), flows (from, to). Boxes sharing a group name form a Group.

boxes.name: Server
boxes.description: Dumb storage: serves workspace files over HTTP, writes whole documents, and broadcasts file-change notifications over WebSocket. No domain logic.

boxes.name: Luminous Canvas projection
boxes.description: Evaluates the active pack view over the graph — containment tree from contain-role edges, arrows, summaries — and emits node, edge, and (soon) cluster declarations for the engine.

boxes.name: Dataflow Designer projection
boxes.description: Maps a Document onto the engine: Boxes to nodes, Flows to directed edges, Groups to cluster declarations and layout cluster ids.

boxes.name: Layout functions
boxes.description: Pure geometry over projected inputs — dagLayout for the Dataflow Designer, composeLayout (grid interior, ELK top level) for Luminous Canvas. Nodes and edges in, positions out, no side effects.

boxes.name: Canvas components
boxes.description: The reactive layer that owns the screen: viewport transform, node rect registry, edge and cluster underlay layers, selection and drag gestures. Not pure functions — this is where state lives.

boxes.name: User input
boxes.description: Pointer and keyboard gestures: pan, zoom, select, drag. Drags become ephemeral position overrides; the next layout run wins.

boxes.name: Browser DOM
boxes.description: The rendered canvas the user reads. DOM data attributes double as the engine's hit-testing index — the DOM is the source of truth for what is clickable.
